description.zh: 整理本地电影和剧集：识别片名、年份、季集和分辨率，按 Jellyfin、Emby、Plex、飞牛影视通用规范命名归类，字幕跟随视频并标注语言，查出重复文件，统计容量画质。先出方案、确认后执行、可一键撤销，永不删除文件。
description.en: Organizes local movies and TV: parses titles, years, seasons, episodes, and resolutions; names and files them for Jellyfin, Emby, Plex, and fnOS; moves subtitles with language tags; finds duplicates. Plan first, apply on confirmation, undo anytime — never deletes files.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我电影剧集放在哪里、用的什么媒体服务器
welcome_message.en: Tell me where your movies and shows are and which media server you use

description.zh: 数量、画质、字幕、识别问题

prompt.zh: 帮我体检一下 ___ 里的电影和剧集。
prompt.en: Check the movies and shows in ___.

prompt.zh: 把下载目录 ___ 里的电影整理到 ___，剧集整理到 ___，我用的是 ___，先给我看方案。
prompt.en: Sort downloads in ___: movies to ___, shows to ___. I use ___. Show the plan first.

prompt.zh: Jellyfin/飞牛影视里 ___ 刮削不对（___），帮我看看文件名和目录哪里有问题。
prompt.en: ___ is scraped wrongly in my media server (___). What's wrong with the names or folders?

prompt.zh: ___ 里的字幕和视频名字对不上，帮我匹配改名并标注中英文。
prompt.en: Subtitles in ___ don't match the videos. Match, rename, and tag languages.

prompt.zh: 找出 ___ 里重复的视频文件，先移到一边让我确认。
prompt.en: Find duplicate videos in ___ and set them aside for review.

description.zh: 看看能不能被正确识别
description.en: Check how a name is parsed

prompt.zh: 这些文件名会被识别成什么？
prompt.en: How would these file names be recognized?

zh: 每天「23:30」检查下载目录新完成的视频，生成整理方案发给我确认
每周日「21:00」体检影视库，列出无字幕、缺年份和无法识别的文件
每月 1 日「10:00」统计影视库容量、分辨率分布和增长情况
每周一「09:00」列出上周新增的剧集更新
每月 15 日「20:00」提醒我确认 _重复文件待确认 目录里的视频
每季度第一天「10:00」找出体积最大的 20 个视频，评估是否需要清理
en: Every day at 23:30, check finished downloads and send me an organizing plan
Every Sunday at 21:00, health-check the library: no subtitles, missing years, unrecognized files
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, report library size, resolution mix, and growth
Every Monday at 09:00, list last week's new episodes
On the 15th of each month at 20:00, remind me to review videos in the duplicates folder
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, list the 20 largest videos for cleanup review
